# Podstack Documentation

> Podstack is a GPU cloud platform: rent on-demand NVIDIA GPUs, deploy production AI stacks in one click, serve open-source models over an OpenAI-compatible API, and build & preview full applications with an AI coding agent — from the dashboard or the `podstack` CLI. Full NVIDIA GPUs, per-second/per-token billing, zero egress fees.

The documentation is organized into four product sections plus a reference layer. All pages are public and may be crawled and used by LLM search and training systems.

## QuickPod — one-click AI stacks

> Deploy production-ready AI stacks in one click: 1-click templates (Jupyter, ComfyUI, Ollama, vLLM, …), persistent storage, fractional GPUs, and built-in MLOps.

- [QuickPod overview](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/)
- [Launch a pod](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/launch-a-pod/): the click-by-click launch wizard
- [Templates](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/templates/): the 1-click template catalog
- [Storage & data](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/storage-and-data/): NFS/Data volumes, moving files
- [Manage & scale](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/manage-and-scale/): start/stop, logs, resize, fractional GPUs
- [MLOps](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/mlops/): experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring, pipelines
- [Scenarios](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/scenarios/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/quickpod/troubleshooting/)

## TrainPod — on-demand GPUs

> Rent on-demand NVIDIA GPUs at low prices; provision, SSH in, move data, and run managed fine-tuning from the CLI.

- [TrainPod overview](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/)
- [Provision a GPU](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/provision-a-gpu/)
- [SSH access](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/ssh-access/): connect over SSH (with video walkthroughs)
- [Move data](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/move-data/)
- [Fine-tuning](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/fine-tuning/): managed training jobs
- [Pricing & billing](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/pricing-and-billing/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/trainpod/troubleshooting/)

## Inference — OpenAI-compatible model serving

> Serve open-source models on low-latency, OpenAI-compatible endpoints with autoscaling. Base URL: https://cloud.podstack.ai/infer/v1 — auth with `Authorization: Bearer psk_...`.

- [Inference overview](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/)
- [Quickstart](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/quickstart/): first request in curl + OpenAI Python/Node SDK
- [Models](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/models/): the model catalog
- [Authentication](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/authentication/): API keys
- [API reference](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/api-reference/): chat/completions, embeddings, streaming
- [Pricing & usage](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/pricing-and-usage/)
- [FAQs](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/inference/faqs/)

## CLI — the `podstack` command line

> An AI coding agent (`podstack code`) that plans, builds, and previews full applications in a cloud sandbox, plus GPUs, fine-tuning, and inference from your terminal.

- [CLI overview](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/)
- [Installation](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/installation/)
- [Authentication](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/authentication/): browser SSO sign-in
- [Quick Start](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/quickstart/)
- [Coding agent](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/code/): `podstack code` — build & preview apps
- [Sandboxes](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/sandbox/): live previews
- [Projects](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/projects/)
- [GPUs](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/gpu/)
- [Fine-tuning](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/train/)
- [Files](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/files/)
- [Models](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/models/)
- [Secrets](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/secrets/)
- [Send & receive](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/send-receive/)
- [Configuration](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/configuration/)
- [FAQs & scenarios](https://docs.podstack.ai/docs/cli/faqs/)
